subject.title: fix(cli): reject invalid task notification policies

question: Should this maintainer-labeled CLI contract change land after direct command-line proof confirms that invalid policies fail before task execution while all three supported policies still run?
rationale: The patch is narrowly targeted, but it deliberately changes an already accepted command-line input into a parse-time failure and carries a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Land with direct CLI proof
options.body: Add redacted terminal output for invalid and supported policies, then merge the closed-contract validation.

options.title: Retain permissive input
options.body: Do not merge if maintainers intentionally support forwarding unknown policy strings to downstream task handling.

recommendation.title: Land with direct CLI proof
recommendation.body: Add redacted terminal output for invalid and supported policies, then merge the closed-contract validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies steipete as the contributor who documented the notification-policy contract and authored the exact CLI change.
